title: What is a Computer Network? - Understanding the Foundation
content:
What is a Network?
Difficulty: ⭐☆☆☆☆
Category: Networking
Estimated Reading Time: 20-25 minutes



⚠ Disclaimer
Had series darat bach tbni foundation qwiya f Networking mn zero. Ma khassek ta knowledge 9bl ma tbda.


IntroductionImagine wa7d l3alam fin kola computer kay3ich bo7do.
Laptop dialk ma y9drch ysift file l PC akhor.
Telephone ma y9drch ykhdm b WhatsApp.
Browser ma y9drch yfta7 Google.
Steam ma y9drch yconnecta l servers.
Online games ma kaynach.
Cloud storage ma kaynach.
Emails ma kaynach.
Streaming ma kaynach.
Bikhtisar…
Modern computing kamla ghadi t7bes.
Hna katban l7aja li smitha Network.
Networking ma hiyach ghir Wi-Fi aw Internet.
Networking hiya l foundation li katkhali millions dyal devices y9dro yhadro m3a b3dyathom.

Why Do Computer Networks Exist?Qbl ma nsowlo:

“Chno hiya network?”

Khasna nfhmo.

3lach aslan khl9na networks?

Jawab sahl.
Computer wahad ma 3ndo ta value kbira.
L9ima katji mlli y9dr ywasel lma3lomat l devices okhrin.
Imagine:

Company 3andha 500 employees.
Kola wa7d 3ando PC.
Kola PC ma3zol.

Kifach ghadi ydir share l documents?
Kifach ghadi ytb3o mn nafs printer?
Kifach ghadi yst3mlo database wa7da?
Kifach ghadi ykhdmo m3a b3dyathom?
Jawab:
Ma ymknch.
L7ell howa…
Network.

What is a Network?Network hiya:

A group of interconnected devices that communicate and exchange information using agreed communication rules called protocols.

Bdarija b simple:
Network hiya wa7d lwasila katkhlli juj aw ktar mn devices ytsifto data l b3dyathom.
Had devices maykounoch ghir computers.
Y9dro ykono:

Laptop
Desktop
Smartphone
Server
Printer
Smart TV
Camera
Router
IoT Devices

Kol wa7d mn hadchi y9dr ykoun node f network.

The Four Building Blocks of Every NetworkKola network, sghira kant aw kbira, mabniya 3la 4 7wayj.
flowchart LRA[Devices] --> E[Network]B[Connection] --> EC[Data] --> ED[Protocols] --> E

1. DevicesDevices homa li diro communication.
Examples:

Computer
Phone
Server
Printer


2. ConnectionBash khas had devices ykono mrabtin.
Bhel:

Ethernet Cable
Fiber Optic
Wi-Fi
Cellular Network


3. DataLhadaf howa data.
Data momkin tkoun:

Image
Video
Password
PDF
Email
Voice
Game Traffic

Networking ma katsiftch “Site”.
Networking katsift data.

4. ProtocolsImagine juj nass.
Wa7d kayhdr English.
Lakhor kayhdr Japanese.
Ma ghaytfahmoch.
Computers tahuma khashom language moshtraka.
Had language katsma:
Protocol.
Protocols homa rules li katnadem communication bin devices.
Examples dyal protocols li ghadi tsanto f had series:

TCP/IP — l’protocol li kaydir base dyal Internet kamel.
HTTP/HTTPS — l’protocol li kayst3mlo browsers bach yjibo web pages.
DNS — l’protocol li kaytarjm smiya (google.com) l IP Address.
FTP — l’protocol dyal transfer dyal files.

Ghadi nt3lmo protocols btafsil mn b3d.

Kola Device 3ndha AddressBach juj devices y9dro yhadro m3a b3dyathom, khass kol wa7d ykoun 3ndo address — bhal number dyal telephone aw adresse dyal dar.
F networking kaynin jouj addresses asasiyin:
IP AddressBhal l’adresse dyal dar dialk.
Kayb2an ykoun unique (aw ghaliban unique) f network, o howa li kayst3mlo router bach y3ref fin ghadi ysift data.
Example: 192.168.1.10
MAC AddressBhal l’ID Card dyal device — mrbota m3a l’hardware nafso (network card).
Kayst3mlo switch bach y3ref chkoun howa had device f local network.
Example: A4:C3:F0:85:AC:2D

⚠ 3lach hadchi muhim f Cybersecurity?
Bzaf dyal attacks classiques (ARP Spoofing, IP Spoofing, MITM) kaykhdmo b l3ab b had addresses — attacker kaykdb 3la network belli howa IP wla MAC dyal wa7d akhor bach y3trd traffic. Ila ma fhmtich addressing mn daba, ghadi ykoun s3ib tfhem had attacks mn b3d.


Network vs InternetNetwork ≠ Internet.
Internet howa network kbira bzaf katrbat millions dyal networks sghar.
Diagram:
flowchart TDA[Home Network] --> E((Internet))B[School Network] --> EC[Company Network] --> ED[University Network] --> E

Internet ma howach network wa7da.
Howa network dyal networks.

Types of CommunicationComputer y9dr yhdr m3a:

Computer
Server
Phone
Printer
Router
Cloud Service


Client and ServerHadi whda mn aham concepts.
Imagine restaurant.
Customer kaytlb pizza.
Chef kaywjd pizza.
Customer = Client
Chef = Server
F networking:
Browser = Client
Google = Server
Discord = Client
Discord Infrastructure = Server
Steam = Client
Steam Servers = Server
Server kay9dm service.
Client kaytlbha.
flowchart LRClient -- Request --> ServerServer -- Response --> Client


Peer-to-Peer (P2P)Machi dima kayn server.
B3d lmerat juj devices kayhadro m3a b3dyathom direct.
flowchart LRA[PC 1] <--> B[PC 2]

Examples:

Local File Sharing
BitTorrent
LAN Games

Had architecture katsma:
Peer-to-Peer.

Real World ExamplesHome Network
Laptop
Phone
TV
Router

Kolchi mrbot.

Company Network
Hundreds of PCs
Servers
Printers
Switches
Firewalls


CloudAWS
Azure
Google Cloud
Hta homa f lakher gha networks kbira bzaf.

Trust Boundaries — Machi Kolchi Kif Kif f NetworkPoint muhim li beginners ghaliban kaynso:
Machi kol device f network 3ndo nafs l’access.
Example dyal Company Network:

Guest Wi-Fi — 3ndha access l Internet biss, ma ymknhach t7bet 3la servers dyal company.
Employee Network — 3ndo access l internal tools (email, files…).
Server Network — mahsora bzaf, ghir IT/Admins y9drو ydkhlo.

flowchart LRGuest[Guest Wi-Fi] -.-> InternetEmployee[Employee Network] --> Internal[Internal Tools]Server[Server Zone] --> InternalEmployee -.->|Restricted| Server

Had fikra dyal “faslin bin l3a2ilat” katsma Network Segmentation, o hiya wa7d mn aham defenses f Cybersecurity: ila attacker dkhel mn Guest Wi-Fi, ma ykounch 3ndo access direct l servers hssasin.
Ghadi nt3m9o fiha f articles jayin.

Attack Surface — 3lach Kola Device Zayda = Risk ZaydF Cybersecurity, kayn concept smito Attack Surface.
Bibasata: kola device jdida li katdkhol l network…
= wa7d l’bab jdid li ymkn attacker ydkhel mno.
Printer 9dema ,  Camera IoT default config، Smart TV b default password…
Kolhom ymknhom ykono l’weak point f network kamla, even if l’PCs mafehom ta misconfig.

💡 Takeaway: Kbar l’network = kbar l’Attack Surface. Had l’idea hiya li katkhli companies ydiro inventory dyal kola device li connecti, o ysdo access li ma khassoch ykoun maftou7.


Why Networking Matters in CybersecurityNetworking howa wa7d mn aham foundations f Cybersecurity.
Attacker khaso yfham:

Fin katmchi data.
Kifach katmchi.
Mnin katmchi.
Chkon kay9raha.
Chkon 3ndo address dial chkon (IP/MAC).

Defender khaso yfham nafs l7wayj, plus  :

Fin l boundaries (segmentation).
Fin l Attack Surface kbira.
Kifach ydir detection l attacks.

Bla base zwina f Networking…
S3ib tfham:

Web Security
Active Directory
Malware
C2
Lateral Movement
DNS
Firewalls
VPN
Packet Analysis
Wireshark


Key Takeaways
Network hiya majmo3a dyal devices mrbotin m3a b3dyathom.
Lhadaf howa communication.
Protocols homa lqawanin li kaynademo had communication.
Kol device 3ndo IP Address o MAC Address bach y3ref o yt3rf m3a b3dyathom.
Internet howa network dyal networks.
Client kaytlb service, Server kay9dm service.
Peer-to-Peer kaykhlli devices ydiro communication directly.
Machi kol network segment 3ndo nafs l’access — Trust Boundaries.
Kola device zayda f network = Attack Surface zayda.


Coming Up Next
How Data Travels Across a Network

Ghadi ntb3o packet wa7da mn browser dialk 7ta twsl l server, step by step — o ghadi nfhmo mzyan difference bin Segment, Packet, o Frame.

References

TCP/IP Illustrated, Volume 1 (W. Richard Stevens)

title: Session Hijacking - Understading Cookie-Based Authentication
content:
Session Hijacking
Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐ ☆ ☆
Category: Web Security

⚠ Disclaimer
Had articale ghaykon educational only.
L’objectif huwa tfham kifash session hijacking ktkhdm o kifash les sites ki9dro ys3bo exploit dialha o kifash nta thmi rask mnha. 


IntroductionKamlin knst3mlo Discord, Instagram, Facebook, Gmail…
Fash katdir login awel mra, kaytlbo mnk:

Username / Email
Password

Walakin mn moraha katwli katdkhol normal bla may3awdo ytlbo mnk password kol mra.
So… kifash hadchi kaykhdm?
Server kaydir creation lwahed Session katremplaci process dial login b user/password.

O ghaliban had Session ID katsajal f Cookie.

Example:stateDiagram-v2    [*] --> Login    Login --> CredentialsSubmitted    CredentialsSubmitted --> ServerVerification    ServerVerification --> LoginFailed    ServerVerification --> SessionCreated    LoginFailed --> Login    SessionCreated --> SetCookie    SetCookie --> BrowserStoresCookie    BrowserStoresCookie --> Authenticated    Authenticated --> [*]

Note: Kayn bzaf dial vulnerabilities o misconfigurations li t9dr tw9a3 f had lmarahil. Ghadi nhdro 3lihom b tafsil mn b3d. 

Daba bash tfham had process mzyan, aju ndiroha step by step.

Nta katktb Username + Password.
Server kayverify credentials.
Ila kano valid, kaycreate Session.
Kayrj3 Session ID b Set-Cookie.
Browser kay7fed Cookie.
Browser kayb9a kaytsift Cookie automatically f ay request.

donc haka mktb9ash kdir login fkol mra tbghi dir chi haja f site ex: instagram. kib9a 3a9l 3lik bdek session.

Session HijackingServer kayb9a 3arfk b Session ID, machi b password.
Nakhdu Pinterest mtalan 
Browser dialk kaykhli ghir:
_pinterest_sess=TWc9PSYyOWRlc1JkM2w1YVloRTFVWFIycWZFN1dFdmdmL2RmdWo2.........TzZ3PQ==

Note: Mashi darori tkon haka session= abdwa (plaintext) f real world Usually opaque/random identifiers. o ta key name mashi darori ykon session y9dr ykon _pinterest_sess bhal f pinterest y9dr ykon smia akhra fsite akhur.

Ama server huwa li kayrbt had Session b information dialk.
Bhal:

Hadchi kaykhtalef mn server l server 3la 7sab implementation.
Donc password beh kndiro create Session.
Mn b3dha Session hia li katwli lkey dial login.
Hna kiji lconcept dial:
 Session Hijacking
Attacker mam7tajch y3rf:

O f b3d scenarios ta MFA t9dr mat3awnch ila kant Session ba9a valid.
3lach?
Hit server kaychof ghir:
Cookie:session=abc123

Ila had Session ba9a valid…
Server kaygol:

“Hada user deja authenticated.”

Wakha li kaydir request ma3ndo ta 3ala9a b owner dial l’account.
flowchart LRA[Victim Logged In]--> B[Browser Stores Session Cookie]B--> C[Attacker Steals Cookie]C--> D[Attacker Imports Cookie]D--> E[Attacker Sends Requests]E--> F[Server Accepts Session]F--> G[Authenticated as Victim]

Hada huwa Session Hijacking.

But…How Can Cookies Be Stolen?Kayn bzaf dial toro9 bash hadchi ywa9e3.
Mn ashharhom:

Stealers

Session Replay hiya technique kikhdmo beha bzf dial websites bash y9dro ychofok kifash katst3ml site dialhom.
B simple words, script load m3a page o kaybda record l interaction dialk:

Clicks

Mn b3d had data katsift l replay server fin owner dial site y9dr y3awd ychof session dialk almost b7al video.

Session Replay mashi attack. Hadi feature katst3mlha companies b7al Hotjar, FullStory, Microsoft Clarity… bash y7sno UX.(User Experience)

Lmochkil kaybda ila:

Sensitive fields ma tmaskawch.
Password fields tsajlo b ghalat.
Personal information (Email, Phone, Address…) ttsift l third-party.
Replay scripts ykon feh misconfiguration.

Dak sa3a replay mab9ash ghir analytics, wla privacy risk.
💡 Modern Session Replay providers kaydiro masking l password fields, credit cards, w sensitive inputs. Walakin implementation dial website hia li kat7dd wash had protection khdama mzyan ola la.

Intercepts Traffic .-> V    A -. Reads Session Cookie .-> S    A -->|Reuse Cookie| S    S -->|Authenticated Session| A

Note
MITM (Man-In-The-Middle) kan momkin ykon sabab f Session Hijacking ila website mazal khdam b HTTP. Hit requests katmchi unencrypted, attacker ila kan f nafs network y9dr ychof traffic w ila l9a Session Cookie valid y9dr yst3mloha.
Lyoum, had lattack wla s3ib bzf m3a HTTPS (TLS) hit requests katkon encrypted, w attacker ma y9drch y9ra Cookie ghir b sniffing. Walakin ila website ma mconfigurach mzyan ola kayn downgrade/misconfiguration, lkhatar mazal kayn.


DetectionSometimes Websites ki9dro ychako.
Examples:

Sudden IP change
Different Country
Different Browser
Impossible Travel
Unusual Activity
Multiple Active Sessions

hadchi li kikhlihom ydiro Force Logout or Require MFA Again

Blue Team PerspectiveDaba 3rfna kifash attacker y9dr ywsl l Session Cookie.
Walakin… kifash defenders y9dro ys3bo hadchi?
Session Hijacking ma t9drch tmna3ha 100%, walakin t9dr ts3bha bzf ila kan implementation mzyan.
Secure Cookie AttributesCookie khasha tkon mconfigura b had attributes:

HttpOnly
Secure
SameSite

HttpOnlySet-Cookie: session=abc123; HttpOnly

Kaymn3 JavaScript mn laccess l Cookie.
Hadchi kay7mi mn bzaf dial XSS scenarios.

SecureSet-Cookie: session=abc123; Secure

Cookie matsiftch ila kan request b HTTP.
Katsift ghir m3a HTTPS.

SameSiteSet-Cookie: session=abc123; SameSite=Lax

Kay9ll mn Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.
Options:

Strict
Lax
None


Session ExpirationSession matkhasshach tb9a valid forever.
Best Practice:

Short expiration for sensitive accounts(Banks).
Invalidate Session after logout.
Rotate Session ID after successful login.


Session RotationMni user kaydir login successfully…
Matb9ach tst3ml nafs Session ID.
Create wa7da jdida.
Old Session↓Destroyed↓New Random Session ID

Hadchi kay9ll mn Session Fixation attacks.

Re-AuthenticationSensitive actions b7al:

Change Password
Change Email
Delete Account
View Recovery Codes

Khas ytalbo:

Password Again

or

MFA Again


Device & Session MonitoringModern websites kikhdmo 3la detection dial suspicious activity.
Examples:

Impossible Travel
Sudden Country Change
Different Browser Fingerprint
New Device
ASN Change
Multiple Active Sessions

Ila chi haja bant suspicious…
Website kidir:

Force Logout
Invalidate Session
Require MFA Again
Notify User


User AwarenessNta as a User khask thawl tb3d 3la had lhwayj.
Avoid:

Installing random extensions.
Downloading cracked software.
Running unknown executables.
Using HTTP websites.
Reusing infected browsers.

Always:

Enable MFA.
Logout from shared devices.
Keep browser updated.
Review active sessions periodically.


Final ThoughtsSession Hijacking ma kat3nich attacker khaso y3rf password.
F bzaf dial cases…
Session Cookie katkon kafiya bash website y3tabrk authenticated.
3liha security dial Session management hiya wa7da mn aham l7wayj f ay web application.
Strong Password, MFA, HTTPS, Secure Cookies, Session Rotation, Detection logic…
Kamlin kaykhdmo m3a b3dyathom bash ys3bo l7ayat 3la attacker.
Remember:

Authentication proves who you are.


Session proves that you’ve already been authenticated.

Ila Session ttsra9…
